verses.1: And the word of Jehovah came to me, saying:
verses.2: Man said to God, “Lord Jehovah, why have you raised me up? I am a mortal, just like any other man. You gave me the heart of a god.”
verses.3: See, you are wise, like Daniel. But all your wisdom is useless and meaningless.
verses.4: In your wisdom and ingenuity, you created gold and silver from your own creations.
verses.5: In the wisdom of your heart, through your blessings, your strength has increased, and it has become stronger in your heart.
verses.6: Therefore, thus said Adonai YHWH: “Because you have put your heart like that of a godless dog.”
verses.7: Therefore, I will bring to you foreigners who are arrogant and proud. They will destroy your cities with all your wisdom. They will also destroy your land.
verses.8: May your soul be raised from the dead, and may you die from death in the depths of the sea.
verses.9: He shall say, “God says: I am before you. You are just a man, and not a god with the power to defile you.”
verses.10: The dead of the enemies were killed by foreigners, because I have spoken, O Lord Yahweh.
verses.11: And the word of Jehovah came to me, saying:
verses.12: The son of man angered the king of Tzor. You said to him, “Thus says the Lord God: You are wise and intelligent.”
verses.13: In the garden of God, you were all precious stones from your own hands. You were like fine gold and silver. Your breasts and nipples were filled with gold and precious stones on that day when you were created.
verses.14: You were taken out from the depths of hell, and you were placed on the holy mountain of God. You were among the stones of fire.
verses.15: You are pure in your ways, from the day of your creation until now. Your purity remains intact.
verses.16: In your great transgressions, you will be covered with ashes. You will be cursed by God, and you will be destroyed like a branch that withers away from the stone.
verses.17: Be proud of your beauty! You have displayed your wisdom in your actions. You were placed on this earth before kings, and you were given prominence in your own eyes.
verses.18: You have made your own ways full of sin; you have desecrated your holy places. Fire will come out from within you. You will be eaten by fire, and you will be left as food for all those who see you.
verses.19: All those who know you in the nations have been defeated by you. You were once powerful, but now you’re nothing more than a worthless being.
verses.20: And the word of Jehovah came to me, saying:
verses.21: The son of Adam turns your faces toward his side, and he stands over him.
verses.22: And you said, “Thus says Adonai Jehovah: I will be with you, and I will protect you. And they shall know that I am Jehovah, who execute judgments in her.”
verses.23: And I sent forth words and blood upon its edges. The heavens were filled with noise inside it. From all around, there was destruction upon it. They shall know that I am Jehovah.
verses.24: And there will no longer be any darkness in the house of Israel. There will be no more pain or suffering from all around them. They will know that I am Jehovah.
verses.25: As Adonai Yehovah said, “I will cleanse the house of Israel from among the nations among whom they have been scattered. I will make them holy before the eyes of all the nations. They shall dwell in the land that I gave to my servant Jacob.”
verses.26: And they shall dwell securely on it. They shall build houses and plant trees. They shall live in peace under my laws, which I will enforce over all those who surround them. They shall know that I, the LORD, am their God.
